chunks: So We made them leave the gardens and springs of water,

key_terms.جَنَّاتٍ: Gardens (plural of Jannah, referring to lush, fertile dwellings)
key_terms.عُيُونٍ: Springs (plural of 'Ayn, referring to sources of fresh water)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the gardens and springs of the disbelievers in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transient nature of worldly power, illustrating how divine justice dismantles the material comforts of the arrogant tribes of 'Ad and Thamud. It serves as a historical precedent for the faithful, reminding them that true security lies not in palaces or springs, but in adherence to divine guidance.
